title: Period formula
text: For a standard sine function $$y=\sin(Bx)$$, $$the$$ $$period$$ $$is$$ $$given$$ $$by$$ $$the$$ $$formula$$ $$2\pi=Bx, $$ or $$\frac{2\pi}{B}.$$

title: Identify B
text: In the given function, the horizontal compression factor $$B$$ is $$2$$.

title: Calculate
text: Substitute $$B=2$$ into the formula. The period is $$\frac{2\pi}{2}=\pi.$$
